sources.evidence: CARIB Brewery's current official St Kitts & Nevis business page states that the company is named CARIB Brewery (St. Kitts & Nevis) Limited and is the leading manufacturer and distributor of beverages in the Federation.
CARIB Brewery's current official contacts page lists CARIB Brewery (St. Kitts & Nevis) Limited at Buckley's Site, Basseterre, St Kitts.
